metadata.description:
Syzygy endgame tablebases for 3, 4, and 5 pieces.

Can be used to find win-draw-loss (WDL) and distance-to-zero (DTZ) information for chess positions containing 5 or fewer pieces remaining (including kings) or in conjunction with a chess engine (e.g., Stockfish) to enhance its analysis/playing strength.

See Wikipedia for more information.
